text: Multi-language Tree Sitter Graph Capability: enable graph capabilities for multiple languages (Python, TypeScript, CSharp, Go, PowerShell, Java, Swift, Kotlin, SQL variants, C, C++) to make the engram server useful for many more project types. Also need to support multi-language project workspaces such as front-end/back-end combined workspaces or mono-repos.
The shim should be able to handle multiple concurrent agent sessions such that only one instance of the server is running but able to meet the requests of multiple agents.

Spike: research refactoring the Engram server from SurrealDB to CozoDB as the primary database, including switching database queries to Datalog and extracting reusable patterns/techniques from the Code Intelligence Engine (CIE) for Datalog-based support across languages Engram aims to support.

Fix backlogit_ship_shipment to validate per-item completion status before archiving. Tool currently accepts any item ID in shipment manifest and deletes the queue file without verifying the item's status: done frontmatter. Items with status: queued/blocked should be removed from the manifest (not deleted from disk). Each archived item's markdown file must be moved to .backlogit/archive/ individually, not just deleted from queue. Tool must emit per-item action log [archived|skipped-not-done|missing] and refuse archive if any manifest item file is missing. See docs/compound/workflow-issues/ship-shipment-overscoped-manifest-2026-04-20.md for full incident analysis.
Dogfood: verify shipment-reconcile pre/post gates during 005-S and 006-S shipments

Forward backlogit_ship_shipment upstream issue to maintainers — draft at docs/upstream/backlogit-ship-shipment-validation-2026-04-20.md — per-item validation, per-item archive, missing-file guard, action log

PROCESS VIOLATION: 007-S was shipped by committing directly to main without a feature branch or PR. The branch protection bypass warning was ignored. Future Ship executions MUST: (1) create a feature branch before the first commit, (2) use pr-lifecycle skill for review and merge, (3) treat branch protection bypass warnings as hard stops requiring operator approval.

Implement SQL parser using tree-sitter-sequel 0.3 — CREATE TABLE/VIEW/FUNCTION/PROCEDURE → ExtractedClass/Function, TDD with 7+ unit tests, IPC integration test. See docs/decisions/2026-04-24-sql-grammar-spike.md for design mapping and effort estimate (~2 hours).

SQL parser: resolve FROM references to known Class nodes in graph. Currently emits References edges with raw identifier strings only; future work should resolve to indexed table Class nodes within the same workspace. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-26-034-F-sql-parser-closure.md

SQL parser: multi-schema reference support (schema.table syntax). Currently only simple identifier references extracted; schema.table patterns like FROM public.users not yet parsed. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-26-034-F-sql-parser-closure.md

tree-sitter-sequel CREATE PROCEDURE support: grammar 0.3 produces ERROR nodes for CREATE PROCEDURE. When a future version supports it, update test_sql_procedure_graceful to expect 1 Function symbol instead of 0. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-26-034-F-sql-parser-closure.md

Phase 5 — CozoDB full parity smoke-test suite: Systematic comparison of all MCP tool responses between surreal-backend and cozo-backend on a real workspace to certify full production parity. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-30-014-s-cozodb-phase3-4-closure.md

concerns_edge column naming inconsistency (task_id/symbol_id vs from/to): The concerns_edge relation uses task_id/symbol_id as key columns, inconsistent with the from/to convention on all other edge tables. Consider a schema migration to rename columns for consistency. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-30-014-s-cozodb-phase3-4-closure.md

CozoDB graph traversal: Datalog-native BFS to replace Rust-side loop: The bfs_impl implementation uses a Rust-side BFS loop rather than a native Datalog fixpoint query. A Datalog-native BFS would reduce round-trip overhead for deep traversals. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-30-014-s-cozodb-phase3-4-closure.md

cozo_vector_test.rs: make vector search tests backend-agnostic for standard CI: The cozo_vector_test.rs tests require the fastembed feature flag. Consider making vector search tests backend-agnostic so they run in standard CI without feature flag switching. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-30-014-s-cozodb-phase3-4-closure.md
Optimize reresolve_references_edges: per-edge UPDATE is still O(N) — batch UPDATE or stored-procedure path when SurrealDB supports it

U015-FLK1: cozo-0.7.6 SQLite unwrap() panic in open_sqlite_db() fires when multiple daemon processes open the same SQLite file concurrently. Affects all integration tests spawning CozoDB daemons. CI workaround: continue-on-error on cozo-backend test step. Fix: upgrade cozo to version with WAL mode or proper error handling.

Stabilize flaky test c018_06_policy_denied_call_records_metrics_with_denied_outcome in tests/contract/atomic_policy_snapshot_test.rs — non-deterministic assertion on denied UsageEvent outcome. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-29-008-S-harness-hardening-closure.md
Improve s_cs4 concurrent indexing test to deterministically trigger IndexInProgress (7003) by adding enough indexable content to TempDir workspace so both index_workspace calls reliably overlap
